com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509
X.509 client certificate authentication: a certificate presented on a dedicated TLS port, or forwarded by a trusted reverse proxy in a header, signs in the user it is bound to (by the SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate) at POST /login/x509, the form of the login page, with the CSRF token.
